_comment: Cards that exist only for the become_copy exception test (tests/unit/copies/test_become_copy_except.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_guardian` is Kimahri, Valiant Guardian's shape -- a permanent in-place copy except its name, vigilance and this ability. `t_lifegiver` is a creature to copy that prints an ability of its own, so the kept ability's seat after it can be checked.

cards.name: Test Guardian
cards.oracle_text:
Vigilance
At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and tap target creature an opponent controls. Then you may have this creature become a copy of that creature, except its name is Test Guardian and it has vigilance and this ability.

abilities.text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and tap target creature an opponent controls. Then you may have this creature become a copy of that creature, except its name is Test Guardian and it has vigilance and this ability.

effects.prompt: Become a copy of that creature?
